lines: A low hum rattles the floor tiles...
Something huge rolls out of the shadows!
The Melodic Subwoofer hums quietly, powered down.
A wall of dead screens flickers to life...
The Cathode Cyclops flickers dimly, powered down.
You fit the two halves of the key together...
A door creaks open where there was only wall before...
You step through into what comes next.
